units: reference units (dependent 8-byte iadd step = 2); the simulator converts to real cycles (x1.049)
memory_note: cost_probes.py memory (memory.json): load+wait on a quiet line 63.9-0.9 ref; second independent load +2.6; stores to one address 35.8-0.9 ref each (repeat-address case only), +4.7 with wait 0. The 2026-10-10 load finding reported ~50 cycles for a dependent chase: unresolved discrepancy.
device_load_note: load-alu-grid.json: a load issued with no ALU instruction since the last wait completes ~45 units after issue (fast); after ALU work ~63 (slow); ALU instructions issued while it is pending defer completion to >= ALU issue + 31 (fast) / + 56 (slow) units. Fit on the 30-point grid.
memstate_note: memstate.json / tgmem.json: a memory instruction is slow when the group issued an ALU instruction while no load was outstanding since its previous memory instruction (stores release the pipe after issue). Slow device loads +~19 latency, threadgroup loads/stores +~19, device stores +~32 group-blocking issue. A device store right after a threadgroup store costs +16.5 (space switch; one measured combination).
quiet_note: Quiet-time rule (supersedes memstate_note): a memory instruction effectively starts no earlier than Q after the group's last ALU issue (Q ~20 units for loads and threadgroup ops, ~33.6 for device stores); loads then complete their fast latency after that start. A wait whose slot has nothing pending costs ~4.85 units (window probe, iadd + k x wait 1 + load); 32 such waits per repetition blow up to 424 units (unexplained).
